ada:sampleName: Three matrix separates, six chondrule fractions (C2, C3, C4; C3m, C3i, C3n) and two bulk rock samples of Allende; BHVO-2
ada:samplingUnit: Digestion aliquot — "All samples (0.3–0.5 g) were digested in closed Savillex beakers"; chondrule fractions "comprise between 155 and ~3000 chondrules each"
ada:proceduralBlankLevel: "Total procedural blanks were between 0.7 and 1.2 ng and thus negligible, given that several hundred ng of Mo were analyzed for each sample"
ada:analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteri: Partially — "For samples analyzed several times, reported values represent the mean of pooled solution replicates". No acceptance or rejection rule stated
ada:betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAnd: External reproducibility from repeated BHVO-2 measurements: ±0.14 for ε97Mo to ±0.39 for ε92Mo (2 s.d., n = 24); Ba ±0.13 for ε135Ba to ±0.31 for ε138Ba (2 s.d., n = 14)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: "The εiMo values obtained for BHVO-2 are indistinguishable from the Alfa Aesar standard, demonstrating that the Mo isotopic data are accurate"
